## Summary of Changes Hello @chrislusf, I'm Gemini Code Assist[^1]! I'm currently reviewing this pull request and will post my feedback shortly. In the meantime, here's a summary to help you and other reviewers quickly get up to speed! This pull request enhances the TiKV integration by addressing previous review comments. It focuses on improving context propagation for read operations to ensure proper timeout and cancellation handling, and refactors the batch deletion mechanism to remove code duplication and improve maintainability. These changes contribute to a more robust and cleaner codebase for TiKV interactions. ### Highlights * **Improved Context Propagation**: Replaced `context.TODO()` with the actual `ctx` in `txn.Get` calls within `FindEntry` and `KvGet` functions. This ensures proper handling of timeouts and cancellations for read operations, making database interactions more robust. * **Refactored Batch Delete Logic**: Introduced a local `flush` helper function in `DeleteFolderChildren` to centralize and de-duplicate the batch flush logic for key deletions. This change eliminates redundant code, making the batch deletion process cleaner and more maintainable.
Using Gemini Code Assist
The full guide for Gemini Code Assist can be found on our [documentation page](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-github-code), here are some quick tips. Invoking Gemini You can request assistance from Gemini at any point by creating a comment using either `/gemini ` or `@gemini-code-assist `. Below is a summary of the supported commands on the current page. Feature | Command | Description --- | --- | --- Code Review | `/gemini review` | Performs a code review for the current pull request in its current state. Pull Request Summary | `/gemini summary` | Provides a summary of the current pull request in its current state. Comment | @gemini-code-assist | Responds in comments when explicitly tagged, both in pull request comments and review comments. Help | `/gemini help` | Displays a list of available commands. Customization To customize Gemini Code Assist for GitHub experience, repository maintainers can create a configuration file and/or provide a custom code review style guide (such as PEP-8 for Python) by creating and adding files to a `.gemini/` folder in the base of the repository. Detailed instructions can be found [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Limitations & Feedback Gemini Code Assist may make mistakes. Please leave feedback on any instances where its feedback is incorrect or counter productive. You can react with :thumbsup: and :thumbsdown: on @gemini-code-assist comments. If you're interested in giving your feedback about your experience with Gemini Code Assist for Github and other Google products, sign up [here](https://google.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_2cyuGuTWsEw84yG). You can also get AI-powered code generation, chat, as well as code reviews directly in the IDE at no cost with the [Gemini Code Assist IDE Extension](https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini/code-assist).
[^1]: Review the [Privacy Notices](https://policies.google.com/privacy), [Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy), [Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms), and learn how to configure Gemini Code Assist in GitHub [here](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/customize-gemini-behavior-github). Gemini can make mistakes, so double check it and [use code with caution](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/13505487).

> [!NOTE] > ## Other AI code review bot(s) detected > > CodeRabbit has detected other AI code review bot(s) in this pull request and will avoid duplicating their findings in the review comments. This may lead to a less comprehensive review. ## Walkthrough Replaces context.TODO() with the caller's context in transactional reads, ensures txn.Get errors are returned from transaction closures, and refactors DeleteFolderChildren to batch deletions via a flush helper invoked on threshold or at completion. ## Changes | Cohort / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **Context propagation in transactional reads**
`weed/filer/tikv/tikv_store.go`, `weed/filer/tikv/tikv_store_kv.go` | Replace `context.TODO()` with the passed `ctx` when calling `txn.Get`, ensuring operations use the caller's context. | | **Error propagation from transaction closure**
`weed/filer/tikv/tikv_store_kv.go` | Add `return err` inside the `RunInTxn` closure so errors from `txn.Get` propagate out of the transactional callback. | | **Batched deletions in DeleteFolderChildren**
`weed/filer/tikv/tikv_store.go` | Introduce a `flush()` helper to accumulate and execute batched deletes when a threshold is reached or at the end; replace immediate per-batch deletes with calls to `flush()` and return its result at completion. | ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant TiKVStore participant TiKVTxn as TiKV Txn rect rgba(135,206,235,0.12) Note over Caller,TiKVStore: FindEntry / KvGet (context propagation) Caller->>TiKVStore: FindEntry(ctx, key) / KvGet(ctx, key) TiKVStore->>TiKVTxn: RunInTxn(ctx) TiKVTxn->>TiKVTxn: txn.Get(ctx, key) TiKVTxn-->>TiKVStore: result / err TiKVStore-->>Caller: return result / err end rect rgba(144,238,144,0.12) Note over Caller,TiKVStore: DeleteFolderChildren (batched deletes) Caller->>TiKVStore: DeleteFolderChildren(ctx, folder) TiKVStore->>TiKVStore: accumulate delete ops alt batch size reached or end TiKVStore->>TiKVTxn: flush() -> execute batched delete in txn TiKVTxn-->>TiKVStore: ack / err end TiKVStore-->>Caller: return final result / err end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes - Inspect the flush helper for correct batching threshold, clearing behavior, and error propagation. - Verify transactional semantics: that batching does not change intended atomicity or visibility. - Ensure the returned errors from RunInTxn integrate correctly with existing retry/isNotExists logic. ## Possibly related PRs - `#7557`: Makes the same TiKV filer changes — propagates context into txn reads and refactors DeleteFolderChildren to use batched transactional deletes. ## Poem > 🐰 I hop through code with careful feet, > > TODOs gone, contexts meet, > > I bundle deletes, then flush with pride, > > Errors returned — no place to hide, > > TiKV fields grow tidy, wide. ## Pre-merge checks and finishing touches

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
